milestones: Understand Java basics: syntax, variables, data types
Learn control structures: loops, conditionals, and methods
Create a simple Java application using learned concepts

dailyTasks.title: Introduction to Java
dailyTasks.description: Learn about Java installation, IDE setup, and basic syntax. Write your first 'Hello, World!' program.

dailyTasks.title: Control Structures and Methods
dailyTasks.description: Understand and practice using loops (for, while), conditionals (if, switch), and methods. Write small programs that utilize these concepts.

dailyTasks.title: Building a Simple Java Application
dailyTasks.description: Combine all learned concepts to create a simple Java application. Focus on using variables, control structures, and methods.

successMetrics: Complete coding exercises using control structures
Build and run a simple Java application with no errors
challenges: Understanding object-oriented concepts if introduced too early
Debugging small errors in code, which may be frustrating
plan.motivationalApproach: Set small goals for each session and reward yourself with breaks or treats after completing each task. Keep a journal to track your progress and celebrate small wins.
